hints.title: Row Orientation
hints.text: Even rows traverse from left to right while odd rows traverse right to left.

hints.title: Alternating Inclusion
hints.text: Maintain a persistent boolean flag that inverts on every visited cell.

hints.title: Output Construction
hints.text: Append elements only when the boolean flag is active.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Visits each grid cell once in alternating direction.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Resetting the skip flag per row desynchronizes the global alternating cadence.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space beyond result array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintains global alternating flag across row-alternating matrix traversal.
